protocol.input: Stage 0 true simulator endings (physics upper bound)
protocol.features: neighbor box-corner displacement in mm (16 corners)
protocol.rule: PC1 best split; BIC 2>1; Ashman D>2; minority>=2; group-mean RMS corner separation > median injected per-chunk max perturbation x scale; same split (<=1 probe) passes at hold step 10 and 30
